Barcelona (preferentemente residentes en Barcelona)

Híbrida (1-2 días presenciales por semana).

En Krell Consulting buscamos un/a Project Manager con experiencia en metodologías Agile y conocimientos de Inteligencia Artificial (IA)
para liderar proyectos tecnológicos y de desarrollo de software en un entorno internacional.

La persona seleccionada será responsable de gestionar proyectos de principio a fin, coordinando equipos distribuidos y promoviendo el uso de herramientas de IA para optimizar los procesos de desarrollo, mejorar la productividad y garantizar la calidad de las entregas.

Liderar proyectos tecnológicos de principio a fin: alcance, planificación, presupuesto, riesgos y puesta en producción.

Adaptar la planificación y estimación de proyectos a equipos que utilizan herramientas de IA como GitHub Copilot, Claude o agentes de IA.
Evaluar el impacto de la Inteligencia Artificial en la productividad y eficiencia de los equipos.
Promover el uso responsable de la IA, garantizando la seguridad, protección de datos y calidad del código.
Facilitar ceremonias Agile y asegurar la correcta aplicación de metodologías Scrum y Kanban.
Realizar seguimiento de proyectos, reporting y comunicación con stakeholders.

🛠️ Requisitos imprescindibles
Experiencia mínima de 5 años como Project Manager
en proyectos de software, tecnología o transformación digital.
Experiencia gestionando equipos distribuidos y proveedores externos.
Conocimientos de herramientas de IA aplicadas al desarrollo de software (Copilot, Claude, agentes de IA o similares).
Experiencia sólida en metodologías Agile, Scrum y Kanban
, así como enfoques híbridos de gestión.
Capacidad para gestionar proyectos end-to-end, controlar riesgos, presupuestos y entregables.
Inglés C1 imprescindible
, para trabajar en entornos internacionales.
Titulación universitaria.
Residencia preferente en Barcelona, aunque se valorarán candidaturas para modalidad 100% remota.

Incorporación a un proyecto tecnológico internacional del sector seguros.
Participación en proyectos innovadores que integran Inteligencia Artificial en los procesos de desarrollo.
Modalidad híbrida en Barcelona.
Salario de hasta 38.000 € brutos anuales
, según experiencia y conocimientos.
Entorno de trabajo internacional, colaborativo y orientado a metodologías Agile.

📩 ¿Te interesa?
Si tienes experiencia liderando proyectos tecnológicos, dominas las metodologías Agile y quieres participar en proyectos donde la Inteligencia Artificial está transformando la forma de desarrollar software, ¡queremos conocerte!

jobs.description:
Job Description

Wabtec Corporation is a global leader in equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail industry.

The ANNAX Group
has been part of Wabtec Corporation since 2018 and operates across three locations in Germany, Switzerland, Italy, and China with over 360 employees. ANNAX provides comprehensive technical solutions to generate, transmit, and display information. Our system solutions for the rail industry include the ANNAX Passenger Information System, which integrates numerous subsystems such as seat reservation, passenger counting, video surveillance, information for visually and hearing-impaired passengers, infotainment/entertainment systems, and more.

Who will you be working with?

You will be part of the Information Solutions product line within Wabtec, focusing on passenger information systems for long and short-distance trains, trams, and metro systems.

You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including software development, QA, testing, and other key stakeholders. In this role, you will also interact with customers and internal teams to ensure successful project delivery and high levels of customer satisfaction.

How will you make a difference?

As a member of the Embedded Software Engineering organization, you will be responsible for leading end-to-end delivery of software projects for Wabtec’s Passenger Information Systems. You will ensure that projects are delivered in line with customer requirements, business goals, technical standards, and agreed timelines and budgets.

You will lead and motivate development teams, coordinate stakeholders, and drive efficient project execution. Additionally, you will manage risks, oversee scope and change management, and support continuous improvement of development and project management processes.

What do we want to know about you?

Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
Proven experience in software project management (5+ years preferred)
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC)
Experience with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, JIRA)
Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to work in cross-functional teams
Fluent English and German (written and spoken)

What will your typical day look like?

Managing end-to-end delivery of software projects
Leading and coordinating software development teams (developers, testers, QA)
Planning project timelines, deliverables, and resource allocation
Monitoring project budgets and ensuring cost efficiency
Managing project scope, requirements, and change requests
Identifying and mitigating risks and resolving issues proactively
Driving communication between internal stakeholders and customers
Supporting contract negotiations, specifications, and milestone planning
Building strong customer relationships and ensuring high satisfaction
Contributing to continuous improvement of project management and development processes

What we offer:

A secure position within an international corporation (Wabtec Corporation, Fortune 500).
Exciting projects in the rail industry using cutting-edge technology.
Flexible working hours and the option for hybrid work.
Opportunities for training and personal development.
An open, collaborative company culture with regular team events

Please note that we do not accept agency candidate submissions without a formalized agreement with Wabtec Talent Acquisition. If you are an agency/third party Recruiter and have not been engaged by Wabtec for this search, we do not owe you a fee if you submit a candidate to the applicant tracking system that is ultimately hired.

Additional Information

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you the person who makes things happen?

You know the type: when a project stalls, they pick up the phone. When a meeting ends without a clear next step, they ask "so who's doing what by when?" When something needs sorting out, it's already sorted. If that sounds like you, we'd like to meet you.

As our Project Manager, you're the person who keeps things moving. You take ownership of projects from the kick-off to the final delivery, and you make sure they actually get finished. You're the link between teams, clients, partners, and other stakeholders: you keep everyone informed, aligned and motivated. We care more about who you are
than about how many certifications you hold. Methods and tools can be learned; drive and people skills are much harder to teach.

In this role you will

Manage projects from kickoff to completion, keeping an eye on scope, timelines and priorities
Turn ideas and loose ends into clear plans with clear owners
Act as the main point of contact, making sure communication flows between everyone involved
Spot risks and roadblocks early and tackle them head-on
Chase decisions, remove obstacles and keep the momentum going
Make sure nothing falls through the cracks

What Do We Offer

An annual gross salary between € 45.000,- and € 75.000,- depending on experience
Continuous challenges and opportunities to grow personally and professionally
International travel: see the world while visiting customers and partners
An international team of talented colleagues
32 days annual leave, pension plan, and hybrid working options

Please note: We do not offer visa sponsorship or relocation for this role.

About Airborne Composites Automation

We are part of the Airborne group, which has been part of the Dutch composites industry for more than 30 years. Airborne started out making composite parts, and today we also use that hands-on manufacturing know-how to build advanced automation systems that make composites production faster, more reliable and fully digital.

From our base in The Hague, we develop and deliver solutions such as our Kit by Light (KBL) cutting and kitting systems and Automated Ply Placement (APP) technology. Our customers work in aerospace, defence, automotive and renewable energy, and include names like Airbus, GKN Aerospace and Lockheed Martin.

We're a team of 40 engineers, builders and problem-solvers who like pushing the boundaries of what's possible in composites manufacturing. That means ambitious projects, international customers and plenty of opportunities for someone who likes to get things done.

Who You Are

A natural communicator. You're comfortable talking to anyone, from a new colleague to senior leadership. You listen well, explain things clearly, and aren't afraid of a difficult conversation.
A go-getter. You don't wait to be told what to do. You see what needs doing and you do it.
Someone who finishes what they start. Deadlines mean something to you, and so does your word.
Organized, but flexible. You like a plan, and you can change it without losing your cool.
A connector. You enjoy bringing people together and getting the best out of a team.
Positive and resilient. Setbacks don't slow you down for long.

What You Bring

Experience coordinating projects, events, teams or initiatives, in any setting (professional, volunteer, student, sports clubs all count).
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering.
Residing within commuting distance of The Hague.
Willing to travel internationally now and then to visit customers, partners and project sites.

Nice To Have (but Definitely Not Required)

A project management certification such as PRINCE2 or IPMA
Familiarity with software tools like Jira and Excel.
Knowledge of Industrial Automation.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway.
We'd rather hire the right person and help them grow than hire a perfect CV.

Please note: We do not offer visa sponsorship or relocation for this role.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Audit Intelligence
jobs.description:
Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing e-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce. 

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world. 

Role Overview

As an Audit Intelligence Senior Program Manager, you will design and scale repeatable intelligence products that continuously monitor customer trust risks, growth drivers, competitive posture, and operational gaps. Moving beyond isolated ad-hoc analyses, you will build automated detection mechanisms that proactively direct organizational attention to high-leverage opportunities. You will transform strategic business questions into scalable AI-driven discovery workflows, turning raw signals into sustainable operational capabilities.

Why This Role Matters

As Coupang scales, the volume of potential opportunities and risks grows exponentially. The challenge is no longer finding data. The challenge is identifying which signals matter. This role builds the intelligence systems that continuously monitor the ecosystem and proactively surface the highest-value customer, commercial, and market opportunities before competitors, customers, or business stakeholders identify them.

What You Will Do

Build Customer Intelligence Programs

You will create intelligence products that help the organization continuously monitor customer trust, pricing competitiveness, and customer value perception.

Examples include, but are not limited to, Blue Badge Trust intelligence, customer competitiveness scorecards, pricing trust deterioration detection, customer-value monitoring, and price sharpness opportunity identification.

Build Commercial Intelligence Programs

You will develop systems that identify where growth, selection quality, and commercial performance can be improved.

Examples include, but are not limited to, Selection opportunity engines, underserved assortment detection, demand decline monitoring, seasonal opportunity discovery, new SKU acceleration frameworks, and tail-of-tail optimization programs.

Build Market Intelligence Programs

You will create mechanisms that continuously monitor market dynamics and competitor activity.

Examples include, but are not limited to, competitiveness monitoring, competitor promotion surveillance, market-share risk detection, and category-level competitive position tracking.

Build Automated Task Generation Systems

You will develop frameworks capable of automatically generating prioritized task rooms and investigation queues.

Examples include creating workflows that automatically generate audit opportunities when competitiveness deteriorates, assign categories requiring intervention, or create task rooms for demand-spike and competitiveness investigations.

Create Executive Intelligence Products

You will build intelligence products that allow leaders to quickly understand where pricing risks and opportunities exist.

Examples include executive dashboards, AI-generated intelligence summaries, weekly competitiveness reviews, customer trust scorecards, and opportunity prioritization reports.

Scale AI Adoption

You will identify opportunities to use AI agents and copilots to improve discovery, investigation, reporting, and prioritization activities.

Examples include GPT-generated business insights, Gemini-assisted market research, Devin-supported workflow automation, and Kiro-enabled task orchestration.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of relevant experience.
Experience leading cross-functional programs.
Strong analytical and business judgment skills.
Experience building operational mechanisms or analytical frameworks.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

Marketplace, pricing, or retail experience.
AI product, automation, or workflow experience.
SQL, Python, or advanced analytics skills.
Product and Engineering partnership experience.

Type of work model

Hybrid

Our Hybrid work model: Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work.

Details to consider

Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran’s benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws.

Privacy Notice

Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below. https://privacy.coupang.com/en/land/jobs/

jobs.description:
At Globe, our goal is to create a wonderful world for our people, business, and nation. By uniting people of passion who believe they can make a difference, we are confident that we can achieve this goal.

Job Description

The Construction Project Manager is crucial for managing the full lifecycle of data center design and construction projects. This position exists to ensure projects are delivered effectively, meeting both quality and budgetary targets within predefined timelines. Operating within the strategic directives set by the Head of Construction Project Management, this role is vital for maintaining the standards and growth objectives of the organization.

Construction Safety: The Construction Project Manager is directly responsible for enforcing a strict safety culture on site, based on the company’s safety standards.
Participate in regular Management EHS walkthroughs and site inspections. Ensure that the general contractor and equipment vendors shall immediately record, address, and resolve site safety issues.
In the event of an incident that affects operations or causes damage to property / injury to a worker, the project manager shall lead or coordinate the prompt development of Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) and detailed sequence-of-events reporting.
Technical Project Execution and Monitoring: Direct day-to-day construction activities, ensuring alignment with agreed project baselines, constraints, and project management processes.
Drive and oversee all project phases, providing technical oversight, maintaining stringent control over schedules and budgets, and ensuring effective deployment of resources.
Manage the installation and commissioning of critical infrastructure, including diesel generators, UPS, chillers, switchgears, and building monitoring systems.
Procurement: Oversee the end-to-end procurement process for hiring of consultants, the general contractor, long lead equipment, as well as processing of supplemental POs while ensuring adherence to project budgets and timelines.
Manage vendor pre-qualification, bid tendering, and contract negotiation, technical evaluation, and Purchase Order issuance ensuring all agreements align with company standards.
Cross-Functional Team Leadership Lead diverse cross- functional teams to accomplish project goals, including consultants for design, project management, testing and commissioning, cost control, offshore technical resources, and in-house construction, finance, legal, operations, and procurement specialists, fostering a collaborative and high- performance environment.
Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance Lead rigorous quality control and assurance programs, ensuring all design and construction activities comply with local/international building codes, environmental regulations, and internal quality benchmarks, and in accordance with design requirements. Manage the rectification of construction defects, maintain a punchlist of defects and ensure that the defects are remedied/resolved on-time.
Advanced Risk Management and Mitigation Proactively identify, analyze, and develop advanced mitigation strategies for complex technical, schedule, and operational risks throughout the project lifecycle to maintain project integrity and timelines. Enforce strict Method of Procedure (MOP) compliance and implement change management processes for all high risk activities.
Stakeholder and Vendor Management Cultivate and maintain exceptional relationships with a broad operating network, including clients, government agencies, contractors, community organizations, and vendors, to facilitate smooth project progression and manage expectations Ensure that commitment to clients and other stakeholders are fulfilled in a timely manner. Provide regular reports and quickly flag and escalate project concerns that could affect delivery timeline, quality, or increase project costs and lead in the resolution of these concerns.
Testing and Commissioning: With the help of the CX consultant and in-house commissioning experts, manage the project through all 6 levels of testing and commissioning culminating in successful Integrated Systems Testing (IST - CX5) and project handover and close-out (CX6) . Ensure full integration of all systems into the Energy & Control Management Systems (ECMS), to enable single-screen visibility for the operations team.
Project Closure and Performance Evaluation Complete all project deliverables, manage final handovers, and conduct in- depth post-project analysis to capture valuable lessons learned and report on final project performance against initial objectives.
Lead the review, approval, and ultimate handover of the project to Operations and the client (when applicable). This includes managing the review of as-built drawings, completion of the as- built BIM model, submission of comprehensive Operations & Maintenance Manuals (OMMs), close-out of punchlists and turnover of rooms to operations.

Requirements

Leadership and Team Management: Lead project teams effectively, promoting collaboration and high performance.
Strategic Thinking: Develop and implement project plans that align with the organization's strategic goals.
Technical Expertise: Extensive knowledge of project management, construction methodologies, and operational best practices.
Communication: Strong capabilities in both verbal and written forms to ensure clear information dissemination.
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional skills in managing relationships and expectations of internal and external stakeholders.
Risk Management: Identify and mitigate potential risks to maintain project integrity and timelines.
Problem-Solving: Ability to address and resolve issues swiftly and effectively.

jobs.description:
Technical Program Manager, Security
Security organization | Program delivery, technical governance, stakeholder leadership

Role Overview
The Technical Program Manager is responsible for driving complex security programs from planning through implementation, adoption and steady state. This role sits at the intersection of technology, security, business stakeholders and change management. The TPM does not need to be the deepest engineer in the room, but must be technical enough to understand architecture and implementation tradeoffs, challenge weak assumptions, identify delivery and security risks, and keep engineering and business stakeholders moving toward the intended outcome.

What makes this role different
This is not a queue-management, project-coordinator or template-driven role. The TPM is expected to operate independently, understand the objective behind program, and create the structure needed to deliver it.
The role requires enough technical depth to engage credibly with security engineers, architects, infrastructure teams and system owners, while maintaining a broader view of business impact, operational risk, communications and change adoption.
The TPM is expected to respectfully challenge assumptions, surface issues that are being avoided, and call out when a proposed approach is unlikely to meet the intended security or business outcome.
Success is measured by outcomes and sustained adoption, not simply by whether tasks were completed or a project plan was updated.

Key Responsibilities
Lead cross-functional security programs from initiation through implementation, stabilization and transition to steady-state ownership.
Build and maintain the program strategy, roadmap, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions and integrated delivery plan.
Translate security objectives into executable work across engineering, architecture, infrastructure, IAM, operations, compliance, risk and business teams.
Facilitate working sessions that drive decisions rather than simply document discussions; clearly identify owners, dates and next actions.
Assess technical implementation approaches and challenge designs, assumptions, sequencing or estimates when they create unacceptable delivery or security risk.
Identify implementation risks across technology, people, process, communications, operational readiness and change management.
Develop executive-ready reporting that communicates progress, key risks, decisions needed, tradeoffs and overall program health.
Manage stakeholder alignment across groups with different priorities and influence without relying solely on formal authority.

Drive change management and adoption activities so that new controls, technologies or processes become operationally effective, not simply implemented.
Establish clear readiness criteria for implementation, production launch, handoff and sustained operation.
Track program outcomes after implementation and drive remediation when the delivered solution is not achieving the intended result.
Maintain strong program hygiene across RAID logs, decision logs, governance forums, action tracking and executive communications.

Required Experience and Capabilities
15+ years of technical program management, technology delivery, security program management or closely related experience.
Demonstrated experience leading at least two complex technology or security implementations from planning through deployment and stabilization.
Working knowledge of enterprise technology and security concepts, with enough technical depth to understand architecture, integrations, dependencies, operational constraints and implementation tradeoffs.
Strong experience coordinating engineers, architects, infrastructure teams, security teams and business stakeholders through complex delivery efforts.
Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and move decisions forward when stakeholders disagree or priorities conflict.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor a message from engineer-level working sessions to executive-level updates.
Experience with risk management, change management, operational readiness and organizational adoption as part of technology implementation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distinguish symptoms from root causes and identify when a program is heading off track.

About the role

Refyne helps India's workforce access the salary they have already earned. The PMO team is where that promise is kept. We own the client integrations that connect employers' payroll systems to our platform, the delivery cadence of our product and engineering PODs, the programs that run across departments, and the response when something breaks in production.

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager who can hold all of it: a portfolio of client integrations, owning the scrum cadence for more than one team, managing programs that span departments, and the incident process behind both the platform and its integrations.

Key responsibilities

Client integrations -
You sit with the client's HR, payroll and IT teams, work out how their system should talk to ours, write the specification and drive the build with engineering through UAT and cutover. After go-live it stays yours.
Scope and solution new integrations across APIs, SFTP and file-based exchanges, and write the technical integration document the client builds from.
Own client configuration end to end: eligibility rules, limits, and translating business logic into technical implementation.
Monitor integrations in production, triage failures and downtime, conduct RCA and escalate with a clear read on client impact.

Act as client's technical counterpart -
Solution calls, demos, business rule questions, infosec questionnaires, due diligence reviews. You are the person on our side who answers without a handoff.
Act as the primary contact for client technical and project stakeholders through the integration lifecycle.
Run demos and user journey walkthroughs for stakeholders.
Collate and close out integration-related infosec and due diligence questionnaires with our security and compliance teams.

Program planning and tracking-
Much of what you own cuts across product, engineering, operations, risk and business teams, and leadership is watching the dates.
Build the plan: scope, milestones, dependencies, owners and a critical path that holds up.
Track delivery across departments, chase the dependencies nobody has claimed, and hold one honest view of status, risks and blockers.
Give leadership the overview they need through weekly delivery reporting, program dashboards and the PMO section of the monthly business metrics report.

Scrum and delivery cadence -
You run the cadence for several product and engineering PODs and keep them moving.
Run planning, grooming, standups, retrospectives and release coordination across your PODs.
Co-ordinate with product and engineering to break requirements into epics and stories with acceptance criteria that hold up, and keep the backlog healthy.
Clear blockers, protect the sprint from mid-flight scope, and keep velocity and release readiness visible in Jira.

Incident management -
When something breaks in production, you run the response and the follow-through.
Run the incident process end to end: detection, triage, the severity call, bridge coordination and client communication while it is still live.
Monitor integration and platform health — API failures, sync breaks, downtime — and escalate with a clear read on employee and client impact.
Close the loop with root cause analysis, preventive actions, and the service and escalation workflows that stop a repeat.

Documentation and governance -
Author and maintain the Client Integration Wiki for every client, to our standard template.
Own the SOPs that govern how configurations are raised, reviewed and changed.
Mentor juniors and interns, delegating real initiatives with clear ownership and checkpoints.

Requirements

6-10 years
in program and project management, implementation or technical account management, with at least 3 years running client-facing technical delivery.
Programs you have run end to end.
Planning, dependencies, stakeholders across several functions, leadership reporting, and the hard conversations about timelines.
Scrum mastery in practice, not theory.

Incident experience.

Writing that holds up.

Stakeholder management.
You can explain a production issue, push back on a timeline and keep the room calm.
A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or the equivalent in practice.

Good to have

A project or agile certification such as PMP, CSM, PSM or SAFe.
Fintech, lending experience.

＜HCLTechについて＞
HCLジャパンは、世界60カ国に広がるHCLTechのグローバルネットワークを基盤に、日本と世界をつなぐIT・エンジニアリングサービスを展開しています。 エイチシーエル・ジャパンではグローバルで培った高度な技術力、専門性、問題解決力を活かし、日本のお客様の製品開発やデジタル変革を幅広く支援しています。

＜ポジション概要＞
本ポジションでは、プログラム全体をリードするProgram Managerとして、大手総合海運企業様向けプロジェクトにてプロジェクト計画の策定から各ゲートでの進捗・課題・リスク・コスト管理、ステークホルダーへのレポーティングまで幅広く担当いただきます。また、顧客の技術開発部門や船舶技術・運航に関わるチーム、外部パートナー、国内外のプロジェクトメンバーなど、多様な関係者と連携しながらプロジェクトを推進していただきます。
これまで培ってきたプロジェクト／プログラムマネジメント力、顧客折衝力、課題・リスク管理力、チームリーダーシップを存分に発揮できるポジションです。
特に、AIの可能性と限界を理解しながら、安全性や品質、サイバーセキュリティにも配慮し、実運用につなげていく重要な役割を担っていただきます。
日英両言語を活用し、グローバルなメンバーや専門家を巻き込みながら、先進的なAIプロジェクトを主体的にリードできる点も魅力です。

＜主な業務内容＞
・プログラム全体の計画策定・進捗管理、週次会議、各種ゲートレビューの運営

・顧客の技術開発・船舶技術・運航部門など、国内外のステークホルダーとの関係構築、調整およびレポーティング
・Delivery Manager、Solution Architect、各領域の専門家、外部ベンダー・パートナーを含むオンショア／オフショアチームの統括・連携
・AIを活用したプロジェクトにおける安全性・品質・サイバーセキュリティの管理、および顧客へのナレッジ移管の計画・推進 など

＜必須条件（MUST)＞
・10年以上のITやエンジニアリング領域でのデリバリー経験や5年以上の大規模プログラムをリードした経験
・日本企業向けのプロジェクトマネジメント経験
・AI、ML、IoT、Edge、デジタルエンジニアリング等のプロジェクトを実証から本番導入まで推進した経験
・ビジネスレベル以上の日本語（目安：JLPT N2以上）、またビジネスレベルの英語力（目安：TOEIL700後半以上、ビジネスにおいての使用経験あり）

＜歓迎条件（WANT)＞
・海運、船舶、港湾、オフショア、航空宇宙、自動車など、安全性が重視される業界でのプロジェクト経験
・AIガバナンス、安全性評価、機能安全、規制・認証プロセス等に関する知識・経験
日本の海運会社、造船会社、船舶機器メーカー等とのプロジェクト経験
・PMP、PgMP、PRINCE2、SAFeなど、プロジェクト／プログラムマネジメント関連資格

大規模かつ複雑なプロジェクトであるため、全体像を把握し課題やリスク、また優先順位を整理しながらフレキシブルかつ主体性をもってプロジェクトを推進してくださる方を求めております。

About The Job

Security is at the core of Google's design and development process: it is built into the DNA of our products. The same is true of our offices. You're an expert who shares our seriousness about security and our commitment to confidentiality. You'll collaborate with our Facilities Management team to create innovative security strategies, investigate breaches and create risk assessment plans for the future. You believe that providing effective security doesn't come at the expense of customer service - you will be our bodyguard (and our long lost pal).

GSRS (Global Security and Resilience Services) Global Intelligence’s mission is to inform business decisions with trusted security risk analysis to protect Alphabet's people, property, and ideas.

In this role, you will join a creative team on Enterprise Threat Assessment (ETA) providing forward-looking security assessments to a wide range of Google decision-makers and leaders across Alphabet’s product areas. You will apply your judgment, security acumen, and open source research skills to support critical functions like risk assessments, global investigations, executive protection, crisis management, and facility security. This position requires established communication skills to build trust within and across teams, ensuring Googlers know where to turn for timely security risk analysis. You must take initiative, thrive in a dynamic environment, have a mindset geared toward process improvement and experimentation (including the use of Artificial Intelligence), and be committed to personal and professional growth.

The Enterprise Threat Assessment Team provides tailored insight into Alphabet's risk landscape through scaled assessment of violence and disruption threats, trends, and groups.

From keeping Googlers safe and secure to managing disruptive events, the ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act are the pillars of Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team. As a member of GSRS you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop programs that drive sustainable effectiveness.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $128000 - $187000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Use publicly available sources to research and evaluate risk based on potential physical security threats or concerns to Google, people, property, and ideas.
Collect, evaluate, and disseminate accurate and timely global intelligence to support action plans based on impact, credibility, and likelihood.
Inform protocols and practices to assess and mitigate threats and potential risks to Google. Partner with security counterparts to make risk-based recommendations.
Author analytic assessments about potential operational and strategic threats/concerns to Google and disseminate to appropriate stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Competitive Intelligence Analyst, Pharma (AI Enabled)
Location: Pune
Type: Full-time

About Anervea Anervea is the AI arm of GRG Health, a healthcare intelligence company. We build software that helps pharmaceutical teams understand their competitive landscape and make faster, better-informed decisions. Our flagship product, AlfaKinetic, is a competitive intelligence platform for pharma. It brings together more than 110 public data sources with GRG Health's own primary research, so commercial and medical teams can work from one place instead of stitching together scattered reports. We are a small, fast-moving team, and this role works closely with the people building and running the platform.

The Role
You will track the pharma competitive landscape and turn scattered signals into decision-ready insight. You will monitor pipelines, trials, and launches, and use the latest AI tools to research, analyze, and build faster. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines real pharma domain depth with genuine curiosity about AI, and who is comfortable not just using AI tools but building with them. You will work directly with our founders and the CI team, and help shape how a growing CI function operates.

What You'll Do
• Monitor pipelines, trials, regulatory milestones, approvals, launches, and label changes across assigned therapeutic areas.
• Track competitors through trial registries, regulatory filings, congresses, investor decks, earnings calls, and news.
• Turn findings into crisp deliverables: competitor profiles, landscape assessments, event readouts, and CI newsletters.
• Use AI tools to accelerate literature review, document analysis, and drafting, then validate everything with human judgment.
• Build and maintain CI assets such as pipeline trackers and competitor dashboards.
• Support brand, medical, and commercial teams with ad-hoc requests, war-gaming, and scenario analysis.
• Track emerging AI tools and bring practical uses into CI workflows.

What you will be responsible for
• Client output check – 100% of client-facing data checked on UAT and Live instance before it reaches the client
• Hand-audit – Manual audit of source data on Nexus datalake for 1 to 5% of data
• Ticket logging and resolution – Logging data issues in JIRA with reproducibility and priority. Providing solutioning approach to engineering team and closing the loop of for resolution
• Turn around – Data QC on QA to be completed in 24 hrs
• UAT approval – Formal UAT approval for all open bug fixes, data accuracy, coverage and relevance 1 day before Go Live

What You'll Need
• 3+ years in pharma or life-sciences competitive intelligence.
• Bachelor's or Master’s (M.Pharm, MSc, MBA, PharmD, or PhD (Good to have) degree in life sciences, pharmacy, biotech, or a related field. • Strong understanding of drug development, clinical trials, regulatory pathways, and commercial pharma.
• Fluency with core CI sources: ClinicalTrials.gov, regulatory databases, scientific literature, and company disclosures.
• Depth in one Therapy area like oncology, haematology, CNS and neuroscience, immunology, rare diseases, cardiometabolic (Good to have)
• Sharp analytical skills and clear, executive-ready communication.
• Hands-on use of AI tools to create deliverables, for example LLMs for synthesis, drafting, or data extraction, and AI-assisted trackers or workflows (Good to have)
• Basic experience of AI and agentic workflows, with vibe-coding familiarity (e.g. Claude Code) to prototype and ship working outputs (Good to have) • Prompt engineering and validation of AI-generated output (Good to have)

What Makes Someone Great at This
• Domain depth. You know where competitive dynamics matter most.
• Analytical rigor. You separate signal from noise.
• AI fluency. You work faster with AI without losing accuracy.
• Communication. You turn analysis into a clear story.
• Ownership. You are proactive and organized under tight timelines.
• Ethics. You operate within legal and ethical CI boundaries.

What We Offer
• Direct work with founders and a close-knit team, with real ownership from day one.
• A front-row seat to how AI is changing competitive intelligence, and the freedom to build with the newest tools.
• Exposure across leading global pharma accounts and therapeutic areas.
• Room to grow as the CI function scales.

How to Apply
Apply through this posting or send your CV to people@anervea.ai

Plan project timelines, book in the team and make sure every deadline has an owner

Run kick-offs, reviews and sign-offs so work moves cleanly from strategy to design to build

Use the AI tools and studio systems we've built on Claude to cut out admin, and help us improve them
Take on your own smaller projects and retainers as you grow

You'll learn from an experienced Client Delivery Lead and spend real time with the CEO on how a studio wins and runs its work. You'll get a learning budget, monthly check-ins on where you want to go, and a clear path to Project Manager as the studio grows.

You're running two or three smaller projects or retainers yourself
Clients on your projects get a clear update every week and know exactly who to call
Timelines and hours on your projects are always up to date, so nothing surprises anyone

Salary

£30,000 to £36,000 depending on experience, plus a discretionary bonus.

Send your CV or LinkedIn and answer the questions in the form, which tell us far more than a cover letter. A degree, or up to two years' experience in project coordination, account management, production or a similar role, ideally at an agency, studio or tech company
Very well organised, with a calm head when several things are moving at once
Clear, friendly writing, and confidence on the phone and on video calls with clients

jobs.title: Oracle Cloud ERP Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Senior Project Manager – ERP/SCM Background

Job Summary

Argano is seeking a Project Manager to lead Oracle Cloud implementations for our clients. Depending on client needs, you may manage several smaller engagements at the same time, such as single-module deployments, phased rollouts, or optimization projects. You may also serve as the dedicated project manager on one larger, multi-pillar implementation spanning ERP/SCM, HCM, EPM, and/or CX. We're looking for someone who is comfortable in both roles and can shift between them as client needs change.

Our ideal candidate has a strong track record delivering Oracle Cloud ERP and Supply Chain projects and a solid understanding of how Financials and Supply Chain connect with the rest of the Oracle Cloud suite. We also value experience leading HCM, EPM, or CX implementations, and we welcome candidates who can bring that range to multi-pillar programs.

You'll be accountable for planning, executing, and closing each engagement on time, within scope, and within budget, while serving as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders and Argano leadership.

Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Delivery

Lead Oracle Cloud implementation projects from initiation through go-live, hypercare, and closure, either managing multiple smaller engagements at once or serving as the dedicated project manager on a larger, multi-pillar program.
When managing multiple engagements, balance priorities, resources, and client commitments so each project stays on schedule and within budget.
When leading a multi-pillar program, coordinate parallel workstreams (for example Financials, Procurement, Supply Chain, HCM, EPM, and CX), managing sequencing, integration points, and shared milestones.
Define scope, goals, and deliverables based on the Statement of Work (SOW), and build project plans covering timelines, resource allocation, and key dependencies.
Plan and run key implementation activities, including design workshops, testing (SIT, UAT, and parallel financial close or reconciliation where applicable), data conversion, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.
Apply Oracle Cloud implementation methodology and scale it to the size and complexity of each engagement.

Team and Resource Management

Work with Center of Excellence (COE) Leads to staff each engagement and adjust staffing as projects move through their phases.
Lead and coordinate functional and technical consultants, workstream leads, integration and data teams, and client counterparts.
Assign tasks, manage resources, and encourage collaboration and clear communication across teams.
Direct the QA Lead to make sure deliverables meet Argano's quality standards and client expectations.

Governance, Risk, and Financial Management

Set up governance suited to each engagement, from lightweight status cadences on smaller projects to steering committees and workstream governance on larger programs.
Manage risks, actions, issues, and decisions (RAID), including cross-project and cross-pillar dependencies, and drive them to resolution.
Develop and carry out risk mitigation plans throughout the project lifecycle.
Maintain a Project Budget Tracker/Burn Sheet for each engagement, and manage change requests against the SOW.
Follow appropriate internal and external escalation processes, keeping Argano leadership and client stakeholders informed.

Stakeholder Communication

Serve as the primary point of contact for client sponsors and project leadership.
Prepare and present status reports to senior management and stakeholders, highlighting milestones, issues, risks, and decisions needed.
Manage expectations across business functions such as Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain and Operations, HR, and Sales/Service, including their competing priorities.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
MBA or relevant master's degree preferred.
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project/program management certification preferred.
Oracle Cloud implementation certifications are a plus.

Experience

8+ years of project management experience, including at least 5 years managing Oracle Cloud implementations.
Full lifecycle, hands-on project management of Oracle Cloud implementations, including managing multiple concurrent engagements and/or leading a larger, multi-pillar program.
Strong experience leading Oracle Cloud ERP and Supply Chain projects, with a solid understanding of modules such as General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, Procurement, Project Portfolio Management, Inventory, Order Management, Manufacturing, Cost Management, and Supply Chain Planning, along with the challenges clients and implementation teams commonly face.
Experience managing Oracle Cloud HCM (Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Talent), EPM (Planning, Financial Consolidation and Close, Account Reconciliation), or CX (Sales, Service, Marketing) projects is highly valued.
Experience managing delivery across multiple workstreams or projects, including shared resources, integrations, data conversion, and competing timelines.
Background in software implementation consulting, ideally with a systems integrator or Oracle partner.
Proven experience with risk assessment and mitigation, quality reviews, and corrective actions.
Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, Asana, or Trello.
Self-motivated, with a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and keeping up with Oracle Cloud releases and industry trends.

Skill Requirements

Project and Program Management: Strong command of project management methodologies and best practices, with the ability to scale them from small engagements to multi-workstream programs.
Prioritization and Adaptability: Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple engagements and adjust smoothly when assignments shift between a portfolio of projects and a single larger program.
Leadership: Strong ability to guide consultants, workstream leads, and cross-functional teams toward successful delivery.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting status, risks, and decisions clearly to executive audiences.
Stakeholder Management: Skill in managing expectations and balancing competing priorities across business functions.
Integration Mindset: Ability to see how decisions in one area affect others, such as how chart of accounts design affects EPM reporting or how Supply Chain setup affects cost accounting in Financials.
Financial Management: Strong discipline in budget tracking, forecasting, and change control.
Quality Assurance: Ensure deliverables meet quality standards and client expectations while directing the QA Lead.
Problem-Solving and Conflict Resolution: Address project issues with practical solutions and resolve disputes within teams or with stakeholders.
Escalation Management: Manage internal communication with Argano leadership and follow appropriate escalation processes.

About Us

Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.

Argano is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

Overview

Program Manager, Identity & Access Management (IAM)
How you can make a difference

We are looking for a Program Manager to bring structure, visibility, and momentum to our Identity & Access Management (IAM) program. In this role, you will connect the work across the IAM organization—partnering with IAM leadership, the IAM Architecture and Engineering, Hygiene, and Application Onboarding teams to build and maintain the program roadmap, run disciplined intake, backlog, and sprint processes, and measure what matters through clear OKRs and metrics. You will also partner closely with IT teams across the organization to understand their identity and access needs, translate those needs into IAM requests and roadmap priorities, and make sure every identity and access requirement is captured, prioritized, and delivered.

In addition, you will work with the IAM teams to explore where AI can support the IAM program and use AI tools where they help with planning and reporting.

What You'll Be Doing

Connect the dots between all functions within the IAM organization and what's happening outside of IAM:
Meet regularly with IAM leaders to keep forward momentum across each IAM pillar, aligning on priorities and clearing any roadblocks that could slow progress.
Coordinate with IT, Security, and Engineering leaders on upcoming and in-flight projects to identify IAM dependencies and support needs early. Use these inputs to inform the IAM roadmap and sprint planning.
Lead IAM-focused requirements gathering with IT teams to identify identity and access needs that IAM can fulfill, translating them into clearly scoped requests for the appropriate IAM team.

Roadmap creation & maintenance:
Facilitate the creation and ongoing maintenance of the IAM program roadmap in collaboration with IAM leadership, IAM architects, and other key IAM team members, adjusting it as priorities shift.
Collaborate with the IAM architect and engineering team to identify emerging IAM trends and technologies that should be incorporated into the roadmap.
Work with the IAM architect and engineering team to identify and build AI capabilities that augment the IAM program.

Intake management:
Participate in each IAM team's intake process, helping prioritize and scope incoming project-based requests.

Backlog management:
Manage and groom the Azure DevOps backlogs for the IAM teams (namely Engineering, Hygiene, and App Onboarding).
Prioritize each team's backlog, focusing on items that will have the greatest impact or are required to execute the IAM roadmap.

Sprint planning:
Facilitate sprint planning for the IAM teams, pulling prioritized items into each sprint based on their sizing and the team's capacity.

Capacity & resource planning:
Build on existing capacity planning practices by providing clear visibility into capacity and utilization across the IAM teams, helping keep work balanced and aligned to priorities.
Partner with IAM leadership to strengthen resource planning, aligning team capacity with the roadmap and incoming demand so the program can continue to scale effectively.

OKRs & metrics:
In collaboration with IAM leadership, define measurable metrics to track the health, compliance, and progress of IAM operations and roadmap execution.
Gather updated metrics on a regular cadence to give IAM leadership a clear view of program performance and roadmap progress.

Reporting, dashboards & data analysis:
Create and maintain IAM reporting dashboards that give leadership and stakeholders a clear, current view of program health, operations, and roadmap progress.
Automate data collection and dashboard refreshes to reduce manual reporting effort.
Analyze IAM data (e.g., access requests, certifications, onboarding, and hygiene metrics) to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities, using AI and automation where applicable.

What you will need to be successful

5+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 3 years supporting an Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance, or Information Security program.
Working knowledge of core IAM concepts and capabilities—identity lifecycle (joiner/mover/leaver), access requests and certifications, role-based access, SSO/federation, MFA, privileged access, and application onboarding.
Hands-on experience with IAM platforms such as SailPoint ISC, Microsoft Entra ID, or BeyondTrust.
Technical fluency in IAM technologies, including how the platforms integrate, where dependencies sit, and what a given change involves, so you can partner credibly with architects and engineers.
Proven ability to build and maintain a multi-team program roadmap and adjust it as priorities shift.
Ability to judge the time, effort, resources, and cost required for IAM initiatives to succeed (for example, application onboarding, platform changes, and hygiene or certification campaigns), and to turn that judgment into realistic estimates, timelines, and budget and staffing inputs.
Experience running Agile practices—intake, backlog grooming, prioritization, and sprint planning—preferably in Azure DevOps.
Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot / Claude) in day-to-day work, such as drafting status updates or summarizing information.
Ability to define, collect, and communicate OKRs and operational metrics that give leadership a clear view of program health, compliance, and progress.
Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with a track record of partnering across IT, Security, and Engineering and influencing without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to AI or automation initiatives within an IAM or security program.
Familiarity with compliance and audit frameworks relevant to access management, such as SOX, HIPAA, PCI DSS, or SOC 2.
Certifications such as PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe, CISSP, or an IAM vendor certification.
Experience in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.

jobs.title: Scientific Research Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive
. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery
and minimally invasive care
, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system
and Ion
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare
, you’ll find your purpose here.

Job Description

Primary Function of Position

The purpose of this role is to serve as a Scientific Research Program Manager (SRPM) for the da Vinci Cardiac Surgery Program. The SRPM, Cardiac surgery will oversee the development of evidence-generation strategy for the Cardiac Surgery Program and support research projects to demonstrate the performance and impact of Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci platforms, products, and services within the United States and globally. This role oversees the initiation, progress, and conduct of evidence-generation studies, including those conducted by internal scientific teams, Intuitive-sponsored studies, and studies conducted in collaboration with external research partners. The SRPM serves as a key contact for internal and external parties involved in assigned projects.

Essential Job Duties

Collaborate with Cardiac Surgery Program leaders and cross-functional evidence stakeholders to identify evidence gaps, align on evidence priorities, and develop evidence-generation plans
Manage and execute a portfolio of internal and external collaborative research studies and evidence-generation activities for Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci platforms, products, and services, with support from research coordinators as applicable.
Manage research studies across the study lifecycle, including project development, budgeting, investigator selection, analysis of potential participant recruitment, preparation of study-related documents (e.g., protocols, case report forms, informed consents, research agreements), and management of Institutional Review Board and/or Ethics Committee submissions through successful outcome.
Collaborate with data management professionals and statisticians as needed; maintain required study documentation; and plan and manage project timelines and budgets to support timely execution.
Proactively identify and communicate project concerns, issues, and delays; develop risk assessments and contingency plans; and prepare project status updates, presentations, and reports for internal and external stakeholders and steering or advisory committees.
Manage publication development, submission, and responses to peer review related to research studies.
Ensure compliance with corporate requirements (e.g., SOPs) and applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., GCP and U.S. and international guidelines), and maintain audit readiness to relevant regulatory and legal standards.
Manage Contract Research Organizations (CROs) and independent research service providers, including partner identification, contract or statement-of-work development, and stakeholder management; facilitate meetings and reporting in accordance with Intuitive Surgical policies; and support review and development of internal research processes (e.g., SOPs).
Build, nurture, and maintain relationships with external research partners and stakeholders, including surgeon key opinion leaders, operating room staff, hospital and health system administrative and technology leaders, surgical and scientific professional society leaders, and healthcare technology industry partners.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

At least five years of experience in an academic setting or healthcare technology industry in a clinical affairs or scientific research function, with evidence of full project management responsibility; industry research management experience preferred.
Knowledge of applicable clinical research and medical device regulations and guidelines, including GCP, ISO 14155, MEDDEV, MDR, and data protection requirements.
Experience developing research protocols and case report forms (CRFs).
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects with competing priorities, including a minimum of three to five research projects across different surgical disciplines and/or products.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with the ability to manage work autonomously and collaborate across teams while maintaining open communication with key stakeholders.
Strong quantitative and literature analysis skills, with the ability to assess data and scientific literature and review data sets for data quality.
Ability to manage CROs, external consultants, research coordinators, or other research staff in the execution of research studies.
Strong problem-solving skills and initiative; English-language proficiency required.

Required Education And Training

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in life sciences, medicine, medical sciences, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field.

Working Conditions

Work may require presence in hospital and surgical/operating room environments. Ability to travel 25%-50% of the time.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Graduate degree in life sciences, medicine, medical sciences, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field.
Five years of experience in the management of research, including clinical research management experience in both academic/hospital and industry settings.
Experience with studies of health information technologies, including artificial intelligence.
Experience publishing research in an academic or industry capacity.
Proficiency in a second language.

Additional Information

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

Mandatory Notices

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR

743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

Preference will be given to qualified candidates who do not reside, or plan to reside, in Alabama, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, or Tennessee.

business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.

Candidate’s Qualifications, Consistent With Applicable Law.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

BCCI, part of the STO Building Group, is seeking a Project Manager in San Francisco.

The Project Manager provides overall construction/business management direction for single and/or multiple projects to ensure quality control, profitability, and client satisfaction. Primary objective is to ensure client satisfaction by understanding and communicating the client’s vision/objectives for the project, producing on time project delivery, and meeting client’s established budget. Manage the overall direction of the project from preconstruction through closeout including contractual and specification documentation compliance, advising on constructability issues, setting quality standards, managing team collaboration, and meeting or exceeding the project’s forecasted profit goals. Provide training and direction to direct reports. Contribute to company’s culture, mission and values through thought leadership and actions.

Current experience managing projects with 12–20 week construction schedules in a fast-paced environment.

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, typically four or more active projects at one time within the past year.

Recent experience in corporate interiors / tenant improvement, including coordination of millwork, furniture integration, lighting design, and architectural finishes.

Up to Date understanding of standard building codes, city permitting processes, and construction documentation requirements.

Current experience working with corporate tenants, ownership groups, designers, and brokers, with a strong emphasis on communication and client relationship management.

Responsibilities

Assume overall project responsibility from preconstruction through closeout to include but not limited to client relations, subcontractor relations, constructability, team collaboration, project schedule, reports and budgets. Set up and maintain all documents that will pertain to the project to ensure procedural and contractual compliance.
Initiate and maintain positive working relationships with clients, architectural/engineering contacts, consultants, subcontractors, vendors and other project team members. Maintain effective working relationships within the various departments of the Company.
Provide an accurate monthly job cost commitment report, over/under billings and cash flow projection for active projects.
Assume responsibility for the monthly billing procedure to ensure it is completed in a timely and accurate manner; set up project billing projections at start of project, review and approve subcontractor invoices and verify timely collection of receivables.
Provide job closeout notification and checklist at least two weeks prior to project completion. Follow up to ensure project closeout is completed in a timely and accurate manner, within four weeks after project completion.
Represent BCCI at all times in a professional manner that is consistent with the company’s values, including maintaining current project-specific knowledge, being prepared for project meetings, proactively communicating with the project team, and meeting deadlines and commitments.
Contribute to company’s culture, mission and values through thought leadership and actions.
Manage subcontractor performance in conjunction with Field Operations and take action to resolve performance issues.

T3 PM JD | BCCI Construction | Page 2

Collaborate with on-site Superintendent to ensure project is built on schedule, within budget and meets or exceeds quality standards and client expectations.
Adhere to Company policies, procedures and performance standards.
Recommend departmental and project process improvements to increase effectiveness, efficiency and productivity.
Facilitate internal and external Lesson's Learned meetings and distribute information to Senior Project Manager, Directors and team members.
Participate in the marketing process, including presentations, RFP responses and attending industry events.
Provide direction and training for the development of Assistant Project Managers and administration support assigned to the team or project.
Perform other projects and duties as assigned.

Qualifications

To perform job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education

College degree in construction management, architecture, engineering, and/or other related fields or equivalent work experience.

Specialized Knowledge and Skills

Knowledge of construction, design, finance, management, estimating cost controls, scheduling and contract management.

Working knowledge of software programs, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, Timberline, Procore, and CMiC.

Experience

3-5 years of project management experience with a demonstrated progression of increased responsibility in project management.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the responsibilities of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Note:
While formal education and degrees are valued, this position places a stronger emphasis on relevant and transferable skills as well as both paid and unpaid experience. Candidates with demonstrated ability through work history, volunteer roles, or other applicable experience are strongly encouraged to apply, even if they do not meet traditional degree requirements.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance, stoop, kneel crouch, or crawl; talk or hear; taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

Work environment

This employee generally performs this work in an office environment. The noise conditions are usually minimal to moderate.

Benefits

The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, Life & AD&D Insurance, Long-term Disability Insurance, Short-term Disability Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Home & Auto Insurance, Family Support, Pre-tax Paid Parking/Public Transportation, Paid time off, Time Away Benefits, 10 Paid Holidays, Group Legal, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Identity Theft Protection, Pet Insurance, Employee Assistance Program

About Us

Founded in 1986, BCCI Construction is a leading West Coast builder with offices in San Francisco, Silicon Valley, Los Angeles, and Orange County. We build relationships in addition to spaces and structures and bring an inherent sense of personal responsibility to every project. Our team has the knowledge and experience to take projects from concept to completion and has assisted leading organizations with realizing their real estate goals.
